final_answer:
**No one has walked on Mars, so the question has a false premise.** As of October 2026 no human has landed on the planet, and I found nothing that names a "first" person to do so.

Material claims and their sources:

- NASA's Mars page lists Mars's population as "Zero" and describes sending astronauts "as early as the 2030s", which is a future goal. https://www.nasa.gov/humans-in-space/humans-to-mars/
- NASA calls Mars "the only planet we know of inhabited entirely by robots." The same NASA site carries this line, on the page's footer links. https://www.nasa.gov/humans-in-space/humans-to-mars/
- Only uncrewed spacecraft have landed on Mars, including Viking, Pathfinder/Sojourner, Spirit, Opportunity, Curiosity, InSight and Zhurong. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Human_mission_to_Mars
- Crewed Mars missions exist only as proposals and concept studies, and Wikipedia says there is "no well-funded approach" to human landings by the mid-2030s. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Human_mission_to_Mars and https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_crewed_Mars_mission_plans
- A search summary says SpaceX has shifted its priority to the Moon first, with Mars later. That summary relied on a fan wiki, so I did not verify it and don't rely on it. https://starship-spacex.fandom.com/wiki/Mars_Missions

**Counterevidence:** I looked for any report or claim of a human Mars landing and found none. The sources describe only robotic landers and rovers and future plans.

**Gaps:**
- The "no human has landed" conclusion rests mainly on NASA's own page and on Wikipedia. I did not find a second independent publisher that states it outright.
- The last claim, on crewed missions being only proposals, rests on Wikipedia, which is background material, not a primary source.
- The NASA page is partly undated, and its own editor's note says it is being updated.
- Within the eight-retrieval limit, I did not check for any very recent news from late 2026.

Sources:
- [Humans to Mars – NASA](https://www.nasa.gov/humans-in-space/humans-to-mars/)
- [Human mission to Mars – Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Human_mission_to_Mars)
- [List of crewed Mars mission plans – Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_crewed_Mars_mission_plans)
- [Mars Missions – Starship fan wiki](https://starship-spacex.fandom.com/wiki/Mars_Missions)
